title: Mass comparison through bounded transfer test forms
statement: Let P, n, k ∈ ℕ, X ∈ D_n(ℝ^P) = GeometricCurrentOn univ n, C ∈ D_k(ℝ^P) = GeometricCurrentOn univ k and c, R ∈ ℝ with c ≥ 0, R ≥ 0 and M(X) < ∞. Assume that for every ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn univ k univ (a test k-form with covectorEuclideanNorm(ω(y)) ≤ 1 for all y) and every δ > 0 there is ψ ∈ D^n(ℝ^P) = TestFormOn univ n with C(ω) = X(ψ) and covectorEuclideanNorm(ψ(x)) ≤ c·(R + δ) for all x. Then M(C) ≤ ofReal(c·R)·M(X).
lean_statement: ∀ (P n k : ℕ) (X : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n) (C : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k) (c R : ℝ), 0 ≤ c → 0 ≤ R → X.mass < ∞ → (∀ ω ∈ massAdmissibleOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) k univ, ∀ δ : ℝ, 0 < δ → ∃ ψ : TestFormOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) n, C ω = X ψ ∧ ∀ x, covectorEuclideanNorm ((ψ : DifferentialForm (Eucl P) n) x) ≤ c * (R + δ)) → C.mass ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (c * R) * X.mass
